description: Verification matrix for all implementation claims. Each item verified against code evidence or flagged as unverifiable.

verification_items.claim: Primary navigation is Dashboard, Missions, AI, Chronilog, Profile
verification_items.evidence: Operator correction 2026-06-03. Prior artifacts listed 'Systems' as 5th tab; operator confirmed Profile is 5th primary tab.
verification_items.notes: Supersedes phase 14.5 convergence plan which listed 'Systems' in primary nav.

verification_items.claim: Systems is NOT a primary navigation item
verification_items.evidence: Operator correction. Systems/secondary features (Contacts, Kanban, Spreadsheets, Canvases, Graphs, Media, Document Vault, Tracker, Settings) are accessible but not in primary 5-tab nav.

schema.ts line 231: onboardingMission integer default 0. Comment: 'Current mission (0-7)'. Also: onboardingStep (step within mission), onboardingCompleted boolean, completedOnboardingMissions integer array.
Documented in replit.md but question set not in VPS snapshot. 6 archetypes confirmed in schema.ts (Warrior, Architect, Creator, Monarch, Oracle, Alchemist). Score fields confirmed.
verification_items.notes: Question count from replit.md. Archetype fields in code confirmed. Actual questionnaire UI not inspectable from snapshot.

verification_items.claim: NOVA is the default AI assistant name
verification_items.evidence: schema.ts line 64: aiAssistantName text default 'NOVA' notNull in user_stats table.

verification_items.claim: User can rename the AI assistant
verification_items.evidence: schema.ts line 64: aiAssistantName is a mutable text field. insertUserStatsSchema (line 585) includes aiAssistantName in pick list, confirming it is a writable/updatable field.
verification_items.notes: UI for renaming documented in replit.md. Field mutability confirmed in code.

verification_items.claim: AI companion supports chat with streaming
verification_items.evidence: conversations + messages tables in schema.ts (lines 1247-1276). @anthropic-ai/sdk and openai in package.json. ws (WebSocket) in deps for streaming. replit.md documents streaming.
verification_items.notes: Chat data model confirmed. Streaming mechanism (WebSocket) deps confirmed. Actual streaming implementation in server code not in snapshot.

verification_items.claim: AI tools: web search, web read, vision goal creation, batch mission creation, uncomplete missions
verification_items.evidence: Documented in replit.md. puppeteer-core + cheerio + turndown in package.json support web search/read. Vision goals + quests tables support goal/mission creation. Tool implementation code not in snapshot.
verification_items.notes: Dependencies support the claim. Actual tool function code not inspectable from snapshot.

verification_items.evidence: Documented in replit.md: server/replit_integrations/chat/knowledge-base.ts with 16 named domains. File not in VPS snapshot.
verification_items.notes: High confidence given replit.md detail level, but not directly verified.

verification_items.evidence: schema.ts lines 47-56: All 5 tokens with current/max pairs, all defaulting to 100/100 in userStats table.

googleapis 171.4.0 in package.json. integrations table with provider/accessToken/refreshToken/tokenExpiry (schema.ts lines 1006-1019). userIntegrations.googleCalendarConnected boolean. calendar_events table with externalId/externalSource. replit.md documents full OAuth flow.

verification_items.evidence: package.json: firebase 11.6.1, firebase-admin 13.6.1, express-session 1.18.1, connect-pg-simple 10.0.0, passport 0.7.0, passport-local 1.0.0, bcrypt 6.0.0. schema.ts: firebaseUid, authProvider, password fields. tests/api-auth.test.ts: confirms register/login/session/logout flow.
No @clerk/* dependency in package.json. No clerk-related fields in schema.ts. No clerk imports visible anywhere in snapshot.
verification_items.notes: Clerk is a future migration target from prior phase plans, not current implementation.

verification_items.evidence: schema.ts contains no RLS policy definitions. Drizzle ORM schema only defines tables, columns, relations, and insert schemas. No policy or security context code visible.
verification_items.notes: RLS would need to be applied at the database level or via Drizzle extensions. Neither visible.

verification_items.evidence: No backup scripts in scripts/ directory (only seed-demo-user.ts, capture-screenshots.ts, kill-port.sh). No backup-related dependencies. No cron/scheduled backup references.
verification_items.notes: Neon may provide automatic backups by default, but this is not confirmed for this specific project.

verification_items.evidence: No .github/workflows/ directory visible. No CI/CD configuration files in snapshot. No GitHub Actions deps.
No Sentry, PostHog, Bugsnag, or similar error tracking dependency in package.json.
tests/ directory contains exactly: api-auth.test.ts (128 lines, 10 tests) and xp-calculations.test.ts (143 lines, 11 tests). Total: 21 test cases.

verification_items.claim: UMH integration layer exists at projections/lyfeos/integration/
verification_items.evidence: 7 Python files totaling 1184 lines. Implements SignalEmitter, CapabilityHandler, OutcomeReceiver protocols. Direct Postgres polling integration.
verification_items.notes: Exists in UMH codebase only. LyfeOS application has no knowledge of UMH.
